name: Binaural Techno
description: Club techno built for headphones: the kick and bass stay locked in the centre while everything else moves between your ears. Hats that hop and circle, acid lines that rotate in phase, kits split by frequency, noise risers that open from a point into a wash, Haas-widened stabs, a hook hidden in the hats and a delta drone for the afterhours. Every sketch is a full track with an intro, a body, a break and a real ending, laid out with one song line, and each explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume sensible.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Hemisphere
sketches.description: A centred kick and clap anchor the room while hats hop between the ears, the bass swings side to side on tiny delays and a 4 Hz binaural drone hums underneath. Intro, two grooves around a break, and an outro that stops on its own, about 1 min 45 s. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Phase Tunnel
sketches.description: An acid line whose interaural phase rotates, half a turn to two turns a second, so it rolls around inside your head, over a pad that steps from centred to diffuse. The breakdown leaves the pad fully diffuse, and the second acid section turns Phrygian and spins the other way. On speakers the 180-degree bars thin out. About 1 min 25 s. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Split Kit
sketches.description: Spectral fusion on the dancefloor: the kit's lows go to one ear and its highs to the other, and the chord stabs send alternate partials to each ear. Neither ear hears the whole groove; together, and in mono, it is complete. In the peak the split moves up and the stabs jump an octave. About 2 min 15 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(126/4)

// 72 cycles, about 2 min 15 s, then a real stop
song("intro@8 groove@16 break@8 groove'@16 peak@16 outro@8", "once")

// earsplit("bands") puts everything below splitfreq in one ear and above it in the other
// The split point rises in the peak, so more of the kit lands in the low ear
drums: s("bd*4, ~ cp ~ cp, [~ hh]*4, hh*16?0.3").earsplit("bands")
  .splitfreq(bysec("peak:1400 *:900")).gain(.6)
  .exceptSections("break").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials: each ear hears a thinner stab
stabs: note("<[d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3]>").struct("~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(env("1200 3200", "section")).decay(.2).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.35)
  .gain(bysec("peak:.17 *:.2"))
  .sections("groove break peak").variant(x => x.delayfeedback(.5))

// The stabs an octave up, only in the peak
high: note("<[d4,f4,a4,c5] [bb3,d4,f4,a4]>").struct("~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(3000).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.1)
  .sections("peak")

// A plain centred bass on the off-beats
bass: note("<d2 bb1>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x")
  .s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.5)
  .exceptSections("intro break outro")

sketches.name: Orbit Hats
sketches.description: Percussion placed around the listener: hats circling once every two bars, a shaker turning the other way, rims hopping from ear to ear and a ride high overhead, all around a centred kick and bass. The orbit section repeats with two different endings: a turn where the kick drops out, then a lift where everything rises. About 1 min 45 s.

sketches.name: Wide Open
sketches.description: Two builds and two drops. The riser starts as identical noise in both ears, a point in the middle of your head, and decorrelates bar by bar until it bursts into a wide wash just as the kick lands. The second drop pushes the chords wider still. About 2 min.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)

// 64 cycles, about 2 min, then a real stop
song("intro@8 build@4 drop@16 break@8 build'@4 drop'@16 outro@8", "once")

// The riser: icorr 1 is the same noise in both ears, near 0 is unrelated noise in each
riser: s("pink").icorr("<1 .7 .4 .1>")
  .hpf(saw.range(300, 6000).slow(4)).gain("<.04 .06 .09 .12>").sections("build")

// After the build the noise stays open as a quiet wash under the drop
wash: s("pink").icorr(.1).hpf(3000).gain(.03).sections("drop")

// A snare roll that speeds up into the drop
roll: s("<sd*4 sd*8 sd*16 sd*16>").gain(saw.range(.15, .5)).hpf(400).room(.3)
  .sections("build")

// The drop: kick, bass and wide chords
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.85).exceptSections("build break")
clap: s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.45).sections("drop")
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("<f1 f1 db1 eb1>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(600).decay(.15).sustain(.3).gain(.45).sections("drop")

// The chords keep playing through the break, darker; in drop' they spread twice as wide
chords: note("<[f3,ab3,c4] [f3,ab3,c4] [db3,f3,ab3] [eb3,g3,bb3]>").struct("x*8")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3).earsh(12).lpf(bysec("break:1200 *:3500"))
  .gain("[.06 .16 .2 .24]*2").room(.4)
  .sections("drop break").variant(x => x.earsh(24))

sketches.name: Cutoff Ping-Pong
sketches.description: Nothing is panned, yet the acid line's brightness bounces between the ears: each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions. The pad is thinner on the right, where a high-pass cuts its body, and thinner still in the break. The second sweep jumps an octave. About 1 min 50 s.

sketches.name: Haas Stabs
sketches.description: Interaural delays as a mixing tool: chord stabs grow wider as their delay rises from 1 to 25 milliseconds, while rims swing from side to side on delays under a millisecond. In the second groove the stabs narrow again bar by bar. The kick and bass have no delay at all. About 1 min 35 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(130/4)

// 52 cycles, about 1 min 35 s, then a real stop
song("intro@4 groove@16 break@8 groove'@16 outro@8", "once")

// A centred kick, clap and bass, with no delay at all
kick: s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.8).exceptSections("intro break")
clap: s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.2).gain(.45).sections("groove")
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2 eb2").s("sawtooth").lpf(650).lpq(3)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.45).sections("groove")

// From about 1 to 30 ms the stabs stay on the leading side but grow wider each bar
// In groove' the order flips and they narrow again
stabs: note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]").struct("~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ x")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).itd("<1 8 15 25>")
  .lpf(2200).decay(.2).sustain(0).room(.3).gain(.22)
  .sections("groove break").variant(x => x.itd("<25 15 8 1>"))

// Under about 0.7 ms the delay moves a sound sideways: the rims swing twice a bar
rims: s("rim*8").itd(sine.range(-.6, .6).slow(.5)).hpf(1500).gain(.22)
hats: s("[~ hh]*4").hpf(7000).gain(.25).exceptSections("intro")

sketches.name: Cents Drift
sketches.description: Dub techno for headphones: a single chord whose ears drift apart in cents, a bar at a time. At 2 cents it beats slowly, at 6 and 12 it shimmers and at 30 it blooms into a chorus inside the delay. The drift section drops the kit and holds the bloom; the last bars slow down into the echoes. A hiss of decorrelated noise rises and falls over the whole piece. About 2 min 15 s.
sketches.source:
setcpm(118/4)

// 64 cycles, about 2 min 15 s, then a real stop
song("intro@8 dub@16 drift@16 dub'@16 outro@8", "once")

// Steady, then a ritardando over the last eight cycles
tempomap("0:29.5 56:29.5 64:25")

// A soft, centred kit
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").lpf(300).gain(.75),
  s("~ rim ~ rim").room(.4).gain(.2),
  s("[~ hh]*4").hpf(7000).gain(.2)
).sections("dub")

// earsh raises the right ear and lowers the left by half the value each
// 2 cents beats slowly; 30 cents widens into a chorus. In the drift it holds the bloom
chord: note("[d3,f3,a3,c4]").struct("~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").earsh("<2 6 12 30>").lpf(sine.range(600, 1800).slow(8))
  .decay(.3).sustain(0).delay(.5).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.55).room(.6).gain(.22)
  .variant(x => x.delayfeedback(.65))
driftchord: note("[d3,f3,a3,c4]").struct("~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").earsh(30).lpf(env("500 2000", "section"))
  .decay(.3).sustain(0).delay(.5).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.6).room(.7).gain(.2)
  .sections("drift")

chord: chord.exceptSections("drift")

// A deep, centred bass
bass: note("<d1 d1 bb0 c1>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.4).sustain(.4).release(.2).gain(.45)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Hiss: unrelated pink noise in each ear, wide and around you, in one arc over the piece
hiss: s("pink").slow(8).icorr(.15).hpf(2000).lpf(6000).gain(env("0 .03@3 .01", "song"))

sketches.name: Ghost Hook
sketches.description: The off-beat hats are white noise, but between the ears they carry a faint hook (Huggins pitch). Each ear alone hears only hiss. In the first hook section a quiet synth plays the hook once every four bars so you know what to listen for; the break strips the groove back to the hidden hook; in the second hook section the hint is gone and only your two ears can find it. The effect is faint and differs between listeners. About 1 min 45 s.

sketches.name: Delta Afterhours
sketches.description: The last hour, lights low: a soft minimal groove over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. Clicks drift around the room and a pad barely moves. In the fade the kit drops away and the tempo eases down until the piece stops. About 1 min 50 s.
